status: authoring direction and exact manuscripts reviewed; four repairs applied in final artifacts

Poison.text: Saves against actual poison or Poisoned effects; checks directly identifying, avoiding, safely handling or disabling an actual poison hazard.

Fire.text: Saves against actual fire-damage or fire environmental hazards; checks directly avoiding, extinguishing or safely traversing a fire hazard.

Cold.text: Saves against actual cold-damage or cold-exposure hazards; checks directly surviving or avoiding an actual cold hazard.

Lightning.text: Saves against actual lightning-damage or electrical hazards; checks directly identifying, avoiding or disabling such a hazard.

Acid.text: Saves against actual acid-damage or corrosive hazards; checks directly handling, avoiding or disabling such a hazard.

Earth.text: Rockfall, cave-in, burial, unstable stone or ground, crushing geological movement or another explicitly physical earth/stone hazard; not every event on stone or earth.

Water.text: Currents, flooding, drowning, undertow, hazardous immersion or another actual water hazard.

Air.text: Hazardous wind, pressure, inhalation, air deprivation or airborne environmental force; not thunder from theme alone.

Psychic.text: Actual psychic damage, mental intrusion or an explicitly psychic hazard; not every mental save or ordinary social influence.

Unholy.text: Only an explicitly mechanically labeled Unholy hazard; never inferred from species, morality, religion, appearance or origin.

Arcane.text: Explicit magical/Arcane traps, wards, fields, environmental phenomena or similar hazards; not every hostile spell or caster action.

Strength.text: STR checks and saves to resist or escape an actual physical hazard, restraint, crushing force, forced movement or entrapment; not attacks, damage, carrying capacity or every STR roll.

Stealth.text: Stealth checks to avoid detection by a present hostile observer, pursuer, guard, sensor or hazard-detection system; no Deception, Initiative, attack bonus or automatic Hidden state.

Vitality.text: CON checks and saves against fatigue, exposure, environmental endurance or disease hazards; never death saves, concentration, Wound/Injury saves or an additional recovery roll.

localCare.timing: after healing and its condition endpoints
localCare.text: After healing and its condition endpoints, choose at most one present local wound, burn, infection or Bleeding source appropriate to topical treatment. A Bleeding source with an existing Medicine-based removal DC permits one immediate WIS (Medicine) check against that DC using this dose as dressing, with no extra healer-kit charge. Do not attempt this if this dose already resolved a healing-triggered removal/treatment attempt for that record. Otherwise it supplies only one expressly required topical dressing/cleaning step in the source procedure; every other time, check, Supply, kit, medicine, rest and cure requirement remains. No defined interaction means no extra condition removal.

benefitCriteria: actual eligible condition removal through a legitimate healing endpoint

panacea.text: Apply over 10 uninterrupted active minutes. On completion, end one present eligible disease, poison/toxin or external curse source, or remove one legally removable Exhaustion level; then attempt 10d6+20 ordinary magical nonspell HP healing. Cure and healing are independent. Use the Director procedure for the recipient season limit, successful-benefit commitment, concurrent-attempt lock and actual source restrictions. No Wound, intrinsic trait, Corruption or resurrection removal.

exactReviewClarifications: Panacea commitment requires an actual successful benefit (cure, positive HP or legitimate healing-triggered condition removal), not interrupted or wholly blocked completion. Only one concurrent attempt; check eligibility again before resolution. No eligible cure skips cure but does not block independent HP attempt.
Full maximum-yield packaging/carrier reservation is mandatory before crafting; unused vials/carrier remain actual ordinary stock.
